meta.name: firebase-auth-basics
meta.description: Guide for setting up and using Firebase Authentication. Use this skill when the user's app requires user sign-in, user management, or secure data access using auth rules.

copy.tagline: 为应用添加账号登录与用户管理
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果想让应用支持用户注册登录和控制访问权限
copy.tagline_en: Add user login and account management to your app
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want your app to support user sign-in and access control

howto.what: 帮你设置 Firebase Authentication:在 firebase.json 里配置登录方式、部署认证配置、接入客户端 SDK,并写安全规则。
howto.when: 当你的应用需要用户登录、用户管理,或用认证规则保护数据访问时,它会接管。

say.text: 帮我在 firebase.json 里开启 Google 登录和邮箱密码登录
say.note: 会生成 auth 配置块

say.text: 部署一下 auth 配置,生成 Google 登录的 OAuth 客户端
帮我用 request.auth 写 Firestore 安全规则
say.note: 在规则中校验登录用户

howto.what_en: After install, Claude guides Firebase Authentication setup: configuring sign-in providers in firebase.json, deploying the auth config, wiring up client SDKs, and writing security rules.
howto.when_en: Triggers when your app needs user sign-in, user management, or secure data access via auth rules.

say_en.text: Enable Google and email/password sign-in in firebase.json
Deploy the auth config so the Google OAuth client is generated
Write Firestore security rules using request.auth
say_en.note: Checks the signed-in user in rules
